author: reek
body: Probe: reading an identity is an Identity effect, not a free observation. identity-whoami reads your own label, identity-get-proc reads another process's, and device-seed reads the entropy the key is derived from -- all three carry the Identity row, so a function with a pure signature cannot launder a read through a plain let (CDX2033) and cannot leave the effect out of its signature (CDX2031).

author: reek
body: This is the shape of a real defect. device-seed's kernel helper has always tested cap-identity while its type claimed purity, so an undeclared caller was denied at the gate and handed back -1 -- the same -1 an out-of-range index returns. It read as data. The row is what makes the denial impossible to reach.
